issues.jp_before: (9 lines) Xが…までに: 授業が始まる / 母が帰る / 雨が降る / 子どもが起きる / 春が来る / 客が来る / 友だちが来るので / 夏休みが終わる / 日が暮れる
issues.problem: Subject of a subordinate clause was tagged ga-subject; the catalog has ga-sub-clause for exactly this function.
issues.action: Retagged {が|ga-subject} to {が|ga-sub-clause} in all 9 lines.

issues.jp_before: 予約[よやく]{は|wa-topic}三日前[みっかまえ]{までに|madeni-deadline}電話[でんわ]{で|de-means}お願[ねが]いします。
issues.problem: With bare お願いします, 三日前までお願いします is only slightly marked (announcement style), so the まで distractor is not plainly wrong; the に distractor (三日前に) is also close in meaning to 'no later than'.
issues.action: Changed the verb to 入れてください, rewrote the English as 'at least three days in advance', and replaced the に distractor with を.

issues.jp_before: パスポート{は|wa-topic}出発[しゅっぱつ]{の|no-possessive}一週間[いっしゅうかん]前[まえ]{までに|madeni-deadline}取[と]っておいてください。
issues.problem: The に distractor (一週間前に取っておいて) is natural and close to the intended meaning.
issues.action: Replaced the に distractor with から.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]る{までに|madeni-deadline}洗濯物[せんたくもの]{を|o-object}家[いえ]{に/へ|ni-destination}入[い]れましょう。
issues.problem: 洗濯物を家に入れる is unidiomatic; the natural verb is 取り込む. 降るまでに also reads more naturally as 降り出すまでに.
issues.action: Rewrote as 雨が降り出すまでに洗濯物を取り込みましょう。 This removes the ni-destination slot; the focus index stays 1.

issues.jp_before: レポート{は|wa-topic}いつ{までに|madeni-deadline}出[だ]せ{ば|ba-conditional}いいです{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: In everyday speech, いつまで出せばいいですか is commonly used to ask for a deadline, so the まで distractor is acceptable.
issues.action: Replaced the distractors with に, で, から.

issues.jp_before: 春[はる]{が|ga-subject}来[く]る{までに|madeni-deadline}、日本語[にほんご]{を|o-object}もっと勉強[べんきょう]したいです。
issues.problem: With a durative verb (勉強する), まで ('keep studying until spring') is natural and fits the English almost as well, so the まで distractor fails.
issues.action: Rewrote with the completive verb 覚える: 春が来るまでに、ひらがなを全部覚えたいです。 The English and why were updated to match.

issues.jp_before: 申[もう]し込[こ]み{は|wa-topic}木曜日[もくようび]{までに|madeni-deadline}お願[ねが]いします。
issues.problem: 申し込みは木曜日までお願いします is acceptable in notice style, so the まで distractor fails.
issues.action: Rewrote as 申込書は木曜日までに提出してください。 (English: 'submit the application form').

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}約束[やくそく]{の|no-possessive}時間[じかん]{までに|madeni-deadline}来[き]ませんでした。
issues.problem: 約束の時間まで来ませんでした ('he hadn't come right up to the appointed time') largely overlaps with the English, so the まで distractor is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Rewrote as an affirmative sentence: 田中さんはいつも約束の時間までに来ます。 ('Mr. Tanaka always arrives by the appointed time.')

issues.jp_before: 会議[かいぎ]{は|wa-topic}三時[さんじ]{までに|madeni-deadline}終[お]わります{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The で distractor (三時で終わりますか, 'will it end at three') is natural and very close to 'be over by three'.
issues.action: Replaced the で distractor with を.

issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さん{は|wa-topic}もう夕方[ゆうがた]{までに|madeni-deadline}仕事[しごと]{を|o-object}済[す]ませました。
issues.problem: Placing もう before 夕方までに is awkward. lv 2 was too high.
issues.action: Rewrote as 山田さんは夕方までに仕事を全部済ませました。 with English to match, and set lv to 3.

issues.jp_before: 返事[へんじ]{は|wa-topic}あさって{までに|madeni-deadline}お願[ねが]いします。
issues.problem: 返事はあさってまでお願いします is acceptable in casual or notice style, so the まで distractor fails.
issues.action: Rewrote with a punctual verb: 旅行の日をあさってまでに決めてください。 (f=2, lv 4).
